jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Overview

Mesh is building the financial operating system that connects exchanges, wallets, and payment flows across the digital asset ecosystem. As we scale, we're looking for a Chief of Staff to be the CEO's closest strategic partner and the executive who makes the company run.

Reporting directly to our Founder and CEO, you'll own how Mesh operates. You'll set the operating rhythm, drive the company's highest-priority initiatives, oversee the Business Operations function, and build Mesh's M&A and Corporate Development function from the ground up. You'll extend the CEO's reach across the company, turning strategy into plans, plans into accountable owners, and owners into results. This is an executive seat on the leadership team: you'll own outcomes, not just coordinate them, and you'll be the person who sources, negotiates, and closes the deals that expand Mesh's reach across crypto and payments.

What You'll Do

 - Act as the CEO's strategic thinking partner on company priorities, key decisions, and tradeoffs, and represent the CEO with the exec team, board, partners, and investors

 - Own Mesh's operating rhythm: annual and quarterly planning, OKRs, weekly leadership reviews, exec meetings, and town halls, so priorities are clear, progress is visible, and decisions don't stall

 - Lead board and investor readiness, including quarterly board updates, exec summaries, and company performance reporting built on a single source of truth for key metrics

 - Oversee the Business Operations function, partnering with the Biz Ops lead to set priorities, remove blockers, and raise the bar for how cross-functional work is scoped, run, and measured

 - Drive CEO special projects end to end, from new markets and strategic partnerships (exchanges, wallets, on/off-ramp partners) to pricing and unit economics

 - Hold the executive team accountable to company goals, surface risks early, and resolve the cross-functional issues that sit between teams

 - Partner with People on org design, executive hiring, internal communications, and culture

 - Build the systems, dashboards, and AI-powered workflows that make company performance easy to see and let Mesh scale efficiently

Who You Are

 - 10+ years of experience, including senior leadership in strategy and operations, business operations, corporate development, or as a Chief of Staff to a CEO at a high-growth company

 - A proven leader who has built a function from scratch, including hiring and managing the team

 - Has owned (not just supported) a company operating cadence: planning, OKRs, exec reviews, and board preparation at a scaling startup

 - Executive presence and sound judgment; trusted by the CEO, board, and exec team, and comfortable giving direct feedback upward

 - Exceptional written and verbal communicator who can turn complexity into clear narratives for the board, leadership, and the whole company

 - Data-driven and commercially minded; comfortable building models and owning company metrics

 - Deep experience in crypto and/or payments processing (stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, on/off-ramps, card and payment networks, regulatory licensing), with a network across the ecosystem

 - Experience in high-growth startup environments (Series B and beyond preferred) and able to travel, including internationally

 - Able to be in the office 3 days a week

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Mesh is hiring its first dedicated Corporate Development lead, a foundational role with a direct impact on the company’s trajectory. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, finance, and technology, you'll need to be as comfortable in a data room as you are interrogating an API integration or stress-testing a settlement architecture with an engineering team.

This is an opportunity to build and own our M&A and strategic partnerships function from the ground up. You’ll define how we identify, evaluate, and execute high-impact opportunities, working closely with leadership to shape where Mesh goes next.

From setting strategy to building a pipeline to closing deals, you’ll operate across the full lifecycle, expanding our capabilities, licensing footprint, and distribution through thoughtful, well-executed partnerships and acquisitions.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in early, unstructured environments, takes initiative, and is excited to turn ambition into action.

What You'll Do

 - Build and own a high-quality pipeline of M&A opportunities and strategic partnerships across the crypto payments ecosystem

 - Lead deals end-to-end: from first outreach through diligence, negotiation, and close

 - Run rigorous diligence across financials, product architecture, API integrations, and commercial viability, you'll go deep enough on the technical stack to assess build-vs-buy tradeoffs, evaluate integration complexity, and identify engineering risk before it becomes a deal problem

 - Develop investment theses, deal frameworks, and scoring models; present insights directly to the CEO, SVP, and board

 - Partner closely with Legal and Finance to structure and negotiate deals that actually get done

 - Stay on top of the competitive landscape, tracking key players, emerging trends, and whitespace opportunities

 - Build and manage relationships with investment banks, advisors, and potential targets, becoming a go-to player in the ecosystem

Who You Are

 - Bachelor’s Degree in Business or Finance or related field

 - 5+ years of experience in investment banking, growth, venture capital, product, or strategy roles, or in-house corporate development at a fintech or crypto company

 - You actually run deals, leading M&A or strategic partnerships from first conversation through close

 - Deep understanding of the fintech and payments industry (on-ramps, off-ramps, PSPs, acquirers, banking partners) and how money actually moves, including working knowledge of EMI / MSB / money transmitter licensing and the regulatory side of the stack

 - Strong grasp of crypto payments infrastructure (stablecoins, on/off-ramps, exchange integrations, custody, compliance),  you know how the pieces fit together in the real world

 - You've evaluated or worked closely with crypto infrastructure at the API layer, whether that's exchange integrations, wallet SDKs, stablecoin settlement rails, or on/off-ramp architecture, and you understand how these systems connect in a real production environment

 - Comfortable getting into the weeds with crypto APIs and exchange integrations (or quick to ramp if you haven’t yet)

 - Sharp financial instincts with the ability to build models from scratch and pressure-test assumptions like a skeptic

 - Technically fluent enough to evaluate a target's API architecture, assess integration complexity into Mesh's stack, and hold a credible diligence conversation with an engineering team, you don't write code, but you know what questions to ask and what the answers mean

 - Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into compelling, board-ready narratives
